questions.question: In your current Senior Accountant role, how do you prepare monthly variance analyses against budget, forecast, and prior-year results, and how do you communicate the key drivers to leadership?
Describe a complex account reconciliation you improved at Amphitheater Public Schools. What was the original issue, how did you identify the source data, and what changed as a result?

This role supports budget development, forecast scenario planning, and program-level decision-making. Can you walk us through a financial model or set of metrics you built to explain account or operational drivers?
Give an example of an internal control issue or audit deficiency you identified and resolved. How did you ensure the corrective action was sustainable?
What has been your role in month-end and year-end close processes, including preparing reconciliations, reviewing account balances, and addressing items requiring adjustment?

The position will work with program directors and non-finance stakeholders. Describe a time you presented financial results or a new process to operational leaders or colleagues with varying levels of financial knowledge.
Tell us about your experience analyzing revenue recognition, receivables, or allowance for doubtful accounts. How did your analysis affect financial reporting or business decisions?
Describe your experience supporting internal or external audits. What schedules, analyses, documentation, or follow-up activities were you responsible for?

You have experience with Oracle, Hyperion, Excel, macros, and accounting-system implementations. Tell us about a system upgrade or process automation project you supported, including your testing, validation, and control responsibilities.

This nonprofit role requires familiarity with GAAP, cost allocation methodologies, Uniform Guidance, and OMB Circulars. How have you applied accounting policies, funding requirements, or cost methodologies in your prior finance and accounting work?
